meta.title: It Depends
meta.description: An interactive course on software architecture decisions, played as a campaign on a living blueprint.

errors.webgl: This sheet needs WebGL to draw the city. Everything else still works: briefings, gauges, ADRs and the review board.
errors.damaged: The saved drawing set was water-damaged. A fresh sheet has been issued.
errors.crashBody: Something failed while drawing. Your progress is saved up to the last issued revision.

tag.more: +{n} more. Hover the force gauges for the rest.
tag.load: No change this revision. Load ≈ {load} orders/day, {pct}% of capacity. Each floor is roughly a doubling of traffic.

briefing.variantNote: Weights shown for an {name}. The city stays Mercadito's; watch the gauge ghosts move.
briefing.rationalePlaceholder: one sentence, in your own words
briefing.rationaleHint: One sentence. The review board will ask.

issued.cloudsOne: One revision cloud. Hover it for the assumption behind it.
issued.clouds: {n} revision clouds. Hover any of them for the assumption behind it.
issued.congestion: Congestion at {name}. It was always going to be a Friday.
issued.late: Arrived late, from Rev {rev}: a change at {name}. Follow the red line.
issued.more: +{n} more entries in the site log.

adr.nygard: Format after Michael Nygard, plus two lines he would forgive.

hints.context: What forces were at play? Team, traffic, money, time.
hints.decision: What did you decide, and how hard is it to undo?
hints.consequences: What gets better, and what gets worse?
hints.givenUp: The option you did not take, and what it would have bought you.
hints.revisit: A condition someone could notice: a number, a date, an event.

adr.rubricNote: The board is a fixed rubric: it checks the shape of your ADR (keywords, length, a condition), not whether the argument is right.

review.title: The review board has three questions about Rev {letter}.
review.senseiPending: The sensei is reading your ADR…
review.rubricNote: A fixed rubric read the shape of your ADR, not its truth: it can count a badly argued point as mentioned. Judging the argument is on you. When Dojo offers a sensei, its notes appear alongside the board.
review.closing: There was no right answer. There was a better-argued one.
review.restore: Restore the site before Rev {letter} and choose differently?

rewind.title: Restore the site before Rev {letter}
rewind.pick: Choose differently. The original stays on file; you will see both cities grow side by side.

cover.kicker: SHEET 0 · COVER · DRAWING SET FOR MERCADITO
cover.title: It Depends
cover.subtitle: A course in architecture decisions, drawn as a city that grows for three and a half years.
cover.opening: Sheet 1 of 8. Q1, Year 1. Three engineers, one database, zero regrets. So far.
cover.howTo: Each sheet moves the company forward one quarter or more. Hover an option to see it pencilled in, write one sentence of why, then watch the consequences arrive, some of them late.
cover.confirmReset: Tear up every revision and start a new campaign?

decide.title: One decision per sheet
decide.body: Read the context and the dilemma. Hover an option to see it pencilled onto the city. Pick one, write one sentence of why, and issue the revision: time moves on and the consequences arrive, some of them late.

forces.title: The forces say what changed
forces.body: Every decision moves these five forces, relative 0 to 100. Hover one to see what moved it, under which assumption and from which source. In the city the same works for any building or red cloud; click a building to open its section.

log.title: The title block is your log
log.body: Every revision you issue is recorded here. After the consequences you write an ADR and the review board reads it. From a revision you can restore the site, choose differently and watch both cities side by side. GUIDE replays this.

titleBlock.empty: No revisions issued. The site is waiting on you.

detail.title: Detail · section through {name}
detail.subtitle: Above grade, what users touch. Below grade, the data and queues it depends on. One floor ≈ a doubling of traffic.
detail.hint: Click to open the section drawing. Esc to come back.

complete.title: Fourteen quarters, one city, your revisions
complete.voice: Every cloud on these sheets was a decision with a reason written next to it. Some of the reasons aged well.
complete.rewind: Any revision can still be restored from the title block: choose differently and watch both cities grow side by side.
